84    /**
85     * @param string|null $gender 'male', 'female' or null for any
86     *
87     * @return string
88     *
89     * @example 'アオタ アキラ'
90     */
91    public function kanaName($gender = null)
92    {
93        if ($gender === static::GENDER_MALE) {
94            $format = static::randomElement(static::$maleKanaNameFormats);
95        } elseif ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
96            $format = static::randomElement(static::$femaleKanaNameFormats);
97        } else {
98            $format = static::randomElement(array_merge(static::$maleKanaNameFormats, static::$femaleKanaNameFormats));
99        }
100
101        return $this->generator->parse($format);
102    }
103

111    public function firstKanaName($gender = null)

117        if ($gender === static::GENDER_FEMALE) {
